title: Revealing User Familiarity Bias in Task-Oriented Dialogue via Interactive Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: An interactive user study comparing the performance and conversational error types (such as 'pretending' behavior and irrelevant responses) of a task-oriented dialogue system when interacting with two distinct user groups: one provided with predefined, constrained goals (closed-goal, high familiarity) and another provided with vague, realistic, and often unsupported goals (open-goal, low familiarity).
